name: duopore-public-course-criteria-comparison
description: Compare courses side by side using the things that matter most to you.

interface.longDescription: Compare courses side by side using the things that matter most to you. Enter your ratings, the weight of each factor and where your facts came from. A total score is withheld when a needed fact is missing. For adults comparing their own options. The app does not look up course facts or predict admission; you supply the information and ratings.
defaultPrompt: Compare these courses using my chosen factors.
Which missing course facts stop me making a fair comparison?

positive.prompt: Use Course Criteria Comparison with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"criteria":[{"criterion":"Schedule","weight":2},{"criterion":"Project work","weight":1}],"programmes":[{"programme":"Programme A","facts":[{"criterion":"Schedule","rating":4,"source":"Provided timetable: evening sessions."},{"criterion":"Project work","rating":3,"source":"Provided syllabus: one project."}]},{"programme":"Programme B","facts":[{"criterion":"Schedule","rating":5,"source":"Provided timetable: flexible sessions."}]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 programmes have all positive-weight criteria supplied.","rows":[{"programme":"Programme A","weightedScorePercent":73.33,"suppliedWeightCoveragePercent":100,"missingCriteria":"","calculationAndSources":"Schedule: 4/5 × 2; Provided timetable: evening sessions. | Project work: 3/5 × 1; Provided syllabus: one project."},{"programme":"Programme B","weightedScorePercent":null,"suppliedWeightCoveragePercent":66.67,"missingCriteria":"Project work","calculationAndSources":"Schedule: 5/5 × 2; Provided timetable: flexible sessions. | Project work: missing (weight 1)"}],"warnings":["Missing programme facts are not treated as zero ratings. Source text is supplied by you; no live programme, quality or admission facts are verified."]}
